contract.B_boundary: B reconstructs and normalizes in FP32 and uses framework FP32 reductions; factoring scales and using binary64 stores changes semantics

contract.control_dot: same lexicographic input-channel/kernel-row/kernel-column order; FP32 RNE fused multiply-add of exact code-level products, +0 initial state
contract.control_implementation: power-of-two equivariant FP32 FMA on grid integers, then exact binary64 power-of-two conversion; no overflow/subnormal in admitted domain
contract.diagnostics: per-node code and raw-state hashes, finite clipping/tie/zero/normalization-overflow counts; new contract diagnostics, no claim of legacy A diagnostic identity
contract.identity_flatten: preserve code/scale state and reshape only
contract.input: original torchvision FP32 transform, then binary64 normalization and finite code RNE
contract.mac_scale_bias: RNE64(RNE64(dot * activation_scale) * weight_scale[channel]); then separate RNE64 add of exactly promoted folded FP32 bias
contract.maxpool: maximum code level ignoring padding, RNE64 reconstruction, output requantization
contract.residual: reconstruct each operand with RNE64(code_level * its scale), add RNE64, requantize once to output node scale
contract.scales: retained positive finite FP32 bits, promoted exactly to binary64; per-node activation and per-output-channel weight
contract.store: RNE64 divide by output FP32 scale promoted to binary64, nearest exact dyadic code level, manifest parity/order ties, finite endpoint clipping
contract.top5: torch topk on final reconstructed binary64 logits; retained B topk remains its original FP32 batch-8 result
contract.weight_codes: original B FP32 normalization, finite levels and code-parity midpoint ties
contract.wide_dot: exact int64 sum of code-grid integer products; proved every prefix <2^53 units; convert exactly to binary64 code-level dot
contract.zeros_specials: canonical +0 at all candidate code stores and zero dot; nonfinite source or raw output fails closed; finite normalization overflow clips endpoint; no silent fallback
